name: electron44-bin
note: Reference only for the layout; the packaged payloads are the upstream Electron release archives, and the launcher is byte-identical to extra/electron44's electron-launcher.sh.
local_adaptations: Split the runtime and chromedriver into two outputs; drop the 134 MB chromedriver.debug blob and the generated buildflags header.
Reuse Arch's electron-launcher.sh (flags.conf handling, ELECTRON_IS_DEV, ELECTRON_FORCE_IS_PACKAGED) instead of the AUR launcher, so the file set matches the electron44 source recipe.

Dependency set re-derived from the shipped ELF files: readelf NEEDED plus the dlopened libpulse and libpci; the libraries Arch links dynamically (brotli, c-ares, libevent, libffi, minizip, opus, zlib, freetype, harfbuzz, libxml2) are static in the upstream payload.
provides=('electron44=44.11.3') and conflicts=('electron44') keep the two providers of /usr/lib/electron44 apart, so applications depend on electron44 either way.
x86_64 only, matching devario-libs/electron44; the linux-arm64 archives exist upstream if aarch64 is enabled later.
